steps.text: Open a managed context for open(path) as f; clean it up on exit. Set records to json.load(f).
Set groups to an empty dictionary.
Set g to groups.setdefault(item['category'], [0, 0]). Increase g[0] by 1. Increase g[1] by item['cost'].
Return a list of [k] + groups[k] for k in the sorted values of groups.
